about: Mission 2, What the town is saying (plan chapter 14, 4.1): after Jiang Deshun's word, Ama Yudrön tells the player the number of animals he can bear to hear (NPC-26's moment), and, asked, who owes whom (thread 9: half the town owes Dechen-tsang, the Pönpo among them, 'which no one mentions'; Gönpo owes it a hide; she is its debtor). The player learns the weight of debt before anyone knows the letter.

a.en: You heard him. Sixty animals from Shöl, the castle will ask. Sixty. A house that trades can bear sixty.

replies.en: Ask her who in Shöl can bear it.

do: Ama Yudrön says the castle will ask sixty animals of Shöl.

b.en: Dechen-tsang can. Half the town owes Dechen-tsang, and the castle owes it most, though nobody says so. Gönpo the coracle man owes it a hide. I owe it my roof.
do: Ama Yudrön, at the chang house: half the town owes Dechen-tsang, the castle most of all, though nobody says so; Gönpo the coracle man owes it a hide; she owes it her roof. If the house's news gets out, all of it moves.

c.narrate: She fills your bowl again before you can cover it.
